description:
This PHP source file defines the `QualificationLanguageController` class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the admin plugin's controller namespace. It appears to be responsible for handling the qualification language list view, utilizing the Vue.js component system.

The class extends an abstract Vue controller and mainly overrides the `preRender` method to initialize a Vue component named 'qualification-language-list'.

classes.name: QualificationLanguageController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for rendering the qualification language list view within the admin plugin, leveraging Vue.js component system.
